{{Recipe summary
| Name = Strawberry Pie
| Category = Recipes for dessert
| Servings = 6–8
| Time = Prep: 25–45 minutes
Baking: 60 minutes
| Difficulty = 3
| image = [[File:Strawberry Pie.jpg|300px]]
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]
== Ingredients ==

* Pillsbury [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie crust]]

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] sliced [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]]

* ¼ cup water
* ⅔ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|Whipped cream]]

== Procedure ==

# Place your strawberries in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and add water, sugar, and lemon juice. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and stir occasionally until thick and syrupy.
# Arrange the pie crust in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]] (unless the pie crust comes with a pan). Pour filling into the pie crust.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 350°F for 60 minutes or until golden brown. Remove pie, and let it cool.
# Serve with whipped cream on top.
